overall_goal: Prepare, wash, and tear lettuce into a bowl

goals.description: Extract and trim the lettuce head
goals.rationale: The person opens the lettuce packet, takes out a head, cleans the knife, and slices off the end of the lettuce.

goals.description: Wash and drain the lettuce leaves
goals.rationale: The person rinses the lettuce under the tap, separates the leaves, and squeezes out the excess water.
The person sets up the digital scales, tares a bowl, and places the lettuce inside to weigh it.

goals.description: Tear and mix the lettuce in a large bowl
goals.rationale: The person transfers the lettuce to a large blue bowl, tears the leaves into smaller pieces, removes the hard core, and mixes the pieces.
